qualifications: Fixtures are local only, outside src and the export. They seed character/trial/rescue/boss/victory prerequisites. This is not a new ordinary full campaign playthrough.

campaign_route loads a saved real early-deck/Trucazo state, completes the native Box/Fool/return paths, then uses the actual journey planner. Its second give after reload did not produce a checkpoint; sewer_reload verifies the identical save from engine startup and the resulting zero-rescue port reload.

direct2/direct4 seed rescue states and boss/Ace eligibility; the native gate, planner, map transition, deployed roster, exact payouts and repeated-claim checks are real. They do not replay the boss fight.
sewer_states reuses #74 isolated flooded-return/escort fixtures; its MAP03 round trip is diagnostic hub persistence, not the campaign route.

reward_isolated/boss_isolated/machines_isolated use the preserved pre-siege MAP06 test overlay, as in #78, to isolate transaction and objective logic. captain_final and knight_final use the actual full city, with objective flags injected rather than a normal battle.

Initial harness attempts are not passing evidence: obsolete Palomo choice indexes, deck left outside the new Box, uncleared arrival conversation, Journal opening timing, and synthetic encounters placed alongside the real full encounter. Corrected runs above retain the actual rules.

A console load invoked during an open dynamic conversation crashed in native menu drawing/wipe. The author saved CrashReport.zip locally. The same sewer82.zds loads via -loadgame and then passes travel/save/reload; original report and minidump remain local. This does not claim the engine open-menu console-load edge is fixed or extend any map-specific save waiver.
Regular-menu save/load and fresh exported first-launch controls remain an explicit author check; native bind queries alone do not claim physical keyboard acceptance.
